name: Герои Эхо недели искажённых — народ одного лица, отбивший нашествие Мешен-Гара «Прилив обличий» (ADR-0023, ADR-0024; docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Искажённые — Мешен-Гар»; RS.weeks в design/ui/roster.js). Пятеро по герою за цикл II–VI: c2-53 Керсу Держащий Облик, c3-54 Иддин Бычий Рог, c4-55 Натту Ворота, c5-53 Зиану Зеркальная Вода, c6-48 Эшму Слово Формы. Задание 30.09.2026: портреты для окон призыва и Эхо вместо инициалов. Рецепт — принятый отряд Иш-Кантуна (jobs/heroes-echo-ishkantun.json) и способ «Глубокий промт персонажа» (art/style/style.md); в рамке — нижний край режет фигуру по поясу, низ плавно уходит в тень без плашки. Раса — Забытые, облик ни на кого из нынешних не похож. Народ одного лица — решение агента по главам: открытые спокойные лица, крупные янтарные глаза, кожа оливково-золотая и матовая, как тонкая глина; никаких масок и росписи на лице; простые одежды с одной полосой у подола, город из сырцового кирпича с кедровыми воротами. Враги недели — Многоликие Мешен-Гара, крылатые быки с людскими лицами, маски поверх масок (jobs/echo-meshengar.json) — только трофеи и угроза за правым краем, фиолетовый туман — цвет искажения. Класс — по оружию и действию, школа — по цвету света. Детали, которых нет в «кто он» и главах, — решение агента, по строке в source
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, heroic character art: a powerful pose, a low camera, strong light from below. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms; the face, the hands and the weapon get the most detail. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no glyphs, no cuneiform, no wedge-shaped marks, no inscriptions on tablets or walls, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no dark band at the bottom, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin; no empty eyes. The hero has exactly one face: no mask worn on the face, no second face, no horns, no wings, no scales or stone skin on the hero.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame, whatever the pose. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge, and the face is seen in three-quarter view looking to the right. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they are; the pose carries weight and intent. Head in the upper third, the face large, well lit and readable at small size, with a clear expression. The lower part of the picture sinks gradually into deeper shadow — no band, no plate, nothing written. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

The hero belongs to the people of one face — a forgotten people who lived long before all the peoples of today, in a walled city of sun-dried brick on a green river plain, not far from the gates of Meshen-Gar. A person of this people has one face and one name for life, and at the city gate everyone names themselves aloud. They look unlike any people living now: their faces are bare, calm and strongly drawn — broad brows, straight noses, full lips and very large, steady eyes of clear dark amber; their skin is a warm olive-gold with a smooth matte look, like fine clay; the men keep short trimmed beards, the women wear their dark hair in one plain braid; none of them ever wears a mask or paints the face. They wear long plain robes and wraps of undyed wool and linen with a single coloured band at the hem, wide leather belts and simple bronze; their city has walls of sun-dried brick and gates of heavy cedar beams. Their enemies were the Many-Faced of Meshen-Gar — people who changed their own bodies at will, growing wings, horns, stone skin or a second face; winged bulls with the faces of men guarded their gates, and their priests wore masks over masks; in the Tide of Forms they spread over the land like a flood of violet mist and took the face of everyone they touched; such things appear only as trophies or as the threat beyond the right edge.

jobs.title: Керсу Держащий Облик — Забытые, контроль (на контроль), Время (c2-53, Эхо, уникальная)
jobs.source: roster.js c2-53: «Из народа одного лица… Называл Многоликим их прежние имена, и на миг их облик держался»; глава «Прежнее имя»: у ворот каждый называет себя вслух; сидел у ворот писцом и помнил всех; знакомых ненавидел сильнее чужих — помнил, как они улыбались; последний, чьего имени он не знал, коснулся его лица. Решение агента: миг заклинания — кричит имя, кольцо зелёного света Времени держит фигуру из фиолетового тумана; тростниковое стило за ухом и в руке, закрытая писчая дощечка у пояса (без знаков). jobs.subject: Subject: Kersu Form-Holder, a man of the people of one face, a controller of the Time school. Who he is: he sat at the city gate as a scribe and remembered everyone who ever came in — even the traders from Meshen-Gar, who changed their faces the way his people change a belt. When the Tide of Forms began, the Many-Faced came against the city wearing the faces of those they had touched in the fields; he went out to them and called them by the names they had once given at the gate, and for a moment their shape held. Right now a shifting shape comes at him, and he calls out its old name. Character: steadfast, sorrowful and fearless — a quiet keeper of names who hates the familiar faces most, because he remembers how they smiled; his brows drawn, his mouth open in a loud call, his amber eyes wide and fierce. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; he stands before the gate, turned toward the right, leaning forward into a wind that whips his robe back. He has exactly two arms: his near arm is thrust out toward the right, the finger pointing, and a ring of green light of the Time school shoots from his hand and closes around a shape of shifting violet mist beyond the right edge, holding it still for a moment; his far hand is clenched at his chest around a reed stylus. Details that tell his story: (1) his fingers are stained with dried clay from years at the gate; (2) a second reed stylus is tucked behind his ear; (3) a closed wooden writing board hangs at his hip on a cord; (4) a plain robe with a single blue band at the hem; (5) a grey feather from a changed one's wing is caught on his sleeve. Place: the great cedar gate of his city at night, lit by two torches, walls of sun-dried brick in deep shadow, and beyond them the river plain swallowed by a towering, creeping violet mist. Green light of the Time school rises from the paving stones below; violet mist from the right.

jobs.title: Иддин Бычий Рог — Забытые, физ ДД силы, Огонь (c3-54, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c3-54: «Боец народа одного лица. Ломал крылатых быков с людскими лицами у ворот Мешен-Гара — рогом, отнятым у первого же»; главы «Бычий рог» (у первого быка было лицо Керсу; рог сидел неглубоко; другого оружия с того дня не брал), «Крылатые у ворот» (по двое у каждой створки; четвёртый упал на него, крылья тяжёлые, как мокрый войлок). Решение агента: удар рогом вправо, в грудь быка у края — видны только каменно-серое крыло и плечо; золотое кольцо на сломанном основании рога; серые перья в волосах. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c3-54-iddin__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-54.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Iddin Bull-Horn, a man of the people of one face, a warrior of great strength of the Fire school. Who he is: with the Tide of Forms came the winged bulls — the guardians of the temples of Meshen-Gar, stone to look at and alive inside. The first one wore the face of his friend, who had gone out to them with his names; Iddin tore out its horn and struck with it, and from that day he fought with nothing but that horn, breaking the winged bulls one after another at the gates of Meshen-Gar. Right now a winged bull charges at him. Character: furious, grieving and unstoppable — he cannot bear a familiar face on a stranger; his brows knotted, his teeth bared in a roar, his amber eyes burning. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he lunges toward the right, his torso twisted, his shoulders driving forward. He has exactly two arms: both hands grip a huge curved horn, pale grey like stone and as long as his arm, ringed with a band of old gold at its broken base, and drive its point forward toward the right into the chest of a winged bull at the right edge of the picture — only a great stone-grey feathered wing and a muscled shoulder of the beast are seen. Scarlet-orange light of the Fire school flares along the horn and bursts at the point of impact. Details that tell his story: (1) the broken base of the horn still carries its gold band, torn from the bull's head; (2) grey stone-like feathers are caught in his hair and on his shoulders; (3) his forearms are bound with leather, scraped raw; (4) a short trimmed beard, a plain robe torn at one shoulder; (5) behind him stands a tall gate flanked by colossal winged bulls. Place: before the tall gates of Meshen-Gar at night: walls of glazed blue brick, colossal winged bulls on both sides, violet mist curling at their feet. Scarlet light of the Fire school rises from cracks in the paving below.

jobs.title: Натту Ворота — Забытые, танк, Земля (c4-55, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c4-55: «Держал ворота своего города против прилива обличий. Кто касался его щита, не мог взять его облик»; главы «Ворота» (тридцать жатв; каждый входящий называл себя и показывал лицо), «Прилив обличий» (закрыл ворота и встал в них; Зиану расставила за спиной чаши с водой), «Щит без отражения» (сырая кожа на дереве, не блестела ни в какую погоду; три дня и три ночи). Решение агента: волна фиолетового тумана с полусложившимися лицами бьётся о тусклый щит и соскальзывает; дальняя рука на засове; чаши с водой у ворот; серое пятно на предплечье, где его коснулись. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c4-55-nattu__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-55.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Nattu the Gate, a man of the people of one face, a defender of the Earth school. Who he is: he kept the gate of his city for thirty harvests, as his father's father had before him: everyone who entered named themselves and showed their face, and he looked whether it was the right face for the name. His shield was raw hide stretched over wood and never shone in any weather — the Many-Faced took the shape of those they touched the way water takes a reflection, but from his shield there was nothing to take. For three days and three nights he held the closed gate. Right now the tide of shifting shapes breaks against his shield. Character: steadfast, stern and weary — an old gatekeeper who does not open; his jaw set, his heavy brows lowered, his amber eyes unblinking; grey in his short beard. Pose, the moment of holding: the camera is low; he stands in the closed gate, turned toward the right, his shoulders driven forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm drives a round shield of dull, matte raw hide forward toward the right, and a wave of violet mist full of half-formed faces breaks against it and slides off, unable to take any shape from it; his far hand grips the great wooden bar across the cedar gate behind him. Amber-orange light of the Earth school glows from the threshold stone below. Details that tell his story: (1) the shield is dull scraped hide with no shine at all; (2) behind him at the foot of the gate stand several bowls of dark clay filled with still water; (3) a heavy bronze gate key hangs at his belt on a thick cord; (4) his robe is plain, with a single dark band at the hem; (5) his near forearm is bare, with a faint grey smear where something touched it. Place: the inside of the city gate at night: walls of sun-dried brick, the great cedar gate bound with bronze, torchlight; violet mist seeping under the gate and through the cracks. Amber light from the threshold stone below; cold violet from the right.

jobs.title: Зиану Зеркальная Вода — Забытые, лекарь, Вода (c5-53, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c5-53: «Лекарка, показывавшая раненым их лицо в спокойной воде, чтобы оно к ним вернулось. Многоликие обходили её чаши стороной»; главы «Чаша воды» (чаши тёмной глины до края, в тени; лицо возвращалось за ночь, по чёрточке), «Чужое лицо», «Своё лицо» (за ночь постарела), «Туман над воротами». Решение агента: протягивает вправо широкую чашу с неподвижной водой, светящейся голубым; ряды чаш за спиной; одна седая прядь в косе. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c5-53-ziana__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c5-53.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Ziana Mirror-Water, a woman of the people of one face, a healer of the Water school. Who she is: still water tells the truth if nobody touches it — her people tested children and oaths that way. She kept bowls of dark clay filled to the brim and set in the shade; those whom the Many-Faced had touched, whose faces were melting like wax near a fire, she sat over a bowl, and the water showed them their own face, and it came back to them — not at once, over a night, line by line. The Many-Faced went around her bowls. Right now she holds out a bowl to a wounded one. Character: calm, compassionate and quietly fearless — a healer who has learned to fear familiar faces; her face serene, her eyes steady, her lips parted as she speaks softly. Pose, the moment of healing: the camera is low; she stands turned toward the right, leaning forward a little. She has exactly two arms: both hands hold out toward the right a wide, shallow bowl of dark clay filled to the brim with perfectly still water, which glows from within with clear blue light of the Water school; the calm light falls on the wounded beyond the right edge; the water is so still that it mirrors the sky. Details that tell her story: (1) behind her, rows of dark clay bowls filled to the brim stand in the shade; (2) her hands are steady — not a ripple on the water; (3) a single grey strand runs through her dark braid; (4) a plain robe with a single blue band at the hem; (5) a wet cloth over her shoulder. Place: a shaded courtyard inside the city walls at dusk: brick walls, a stone basin, and over the walls a violet mist creeping in from the fields. Blue light rises from the bowls below; violet mist from the right.

jobs.subject: Subject: Eshmu Word-of-Form, a man of the people of one face, a battle mage of the Light school. Who he is: as a young man he went to Meshen-Gar to study — they knew more about form than anyone. Later he took the masks off a fallen priest — of bronze, clay, feathers, leather and wax, seven of them — and under the seventh there was nothing, smooth as an egg. For nine nights he searched for one word — the old name of everything at once, after which each thing remembers its own form — and on the tenth he found it. At the gates of Meshen-Gar he said it aloud, and the Many-Faced scattered like fog before the wind. Right now he speaks the word. Character: wise, grave and terrible in his certainty — an old scholar with no pity left; his head thrown back, his mouth open in the word, his amber eyes wide and shining with light. Pose, the moment of the word: the camera is low; he stands before tall gates, turned toward the right, his chest thrown forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm is raised toward the right, the palm open, and a blinding wave of pale golden light of the Light school bursts from his palm toward the gates beyond the right edge, tearing the violet mist into shreds; his far hand clutches at his chest a cord from which hang seven empty masks — of bronze, clay, feathers, leather and wax. Details that tell his story: (1) the seven masks on the cord, the last one completely plain; (2) a short grey beard and deep lines on his forehead; (3) a scholar's plain robe with a single band at the hem, dusty from the road; (4) a traveller's staff strapped across his back; (5) the paving stones under his feet turn sharp and clean where the light falls. Place: before the tall gates of Meshen-Gar at night: walls of glazed blue brick, colossal winged bulls turning back into plain stone as the light touches them, the violet mist torn apart and fleeing. Pale golden light of the Light school rises from the paving below and blazes from his hand.
